hypothesis: The balanced localizer recovers difficult red geometry, while window2 crop retraining recovers blue classification. Evaluate their composition and both component controls before deciding whether those complementary improvements survive full-scene retention checks.
design: For each seed and policy, cross parent/control/balanced localizer proposals with parent/control/admit classifiers. Reuse hash-verified fixed proposals; freshly classify all crops and rerun selection. Reproduce every parent-classifier result from the localizer audit. No ensembling, extra per-frame inference calls, new training, threshold search or label-conditioned routing.
gate: For both seeds, candidate balanced+admit must lose no incumbent target and add no per-color false positives on each of the three TRAIN panels, with at least one recovered target overall. Passing permits a separate export and development investigation only. Record comparisons with full matched control and each component ablation; neither previously rejected component is independently promoted.
